name: What is the warranty typically offered on new tankless water heaters?

mainEntity.name: What is the warranty typically offered on new tankless water heaters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranties for new tankless water heaters vary by manufacturer and model. Typically, you can expect a heat exchanger warranty of 10-15 years, and a parts warranty of 3-5 years. Labor warranties for installation are usually provided by the plumbing company and can range from 1-2 years. Always review the specific warranty details before making a purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Warranties vary, but typically include 10-15 years for the heat exchanger and 3-5 years for parts. Installation labor warranties are separate.
